venue.name: [Robinsons Cybergate Cebu](http://www.robinsonsmalls.com/mall-info/robinsons-cybergate-cebu)

information: Registration fee(Inclusion: certificate of participation and raffle entry) starts at Php 250.00 for the first 3 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. Registration closes on February 12, 2017 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Strictly no refund after the registration cut-off and no walk-in registrations on the day of the event.
